items.title: Meduza: ‘Please return this precious papa to his little daughter’: Wife of Japanese journalist jailed in Russia on espionage charges pleads for his release
items.content_text: The Japanese newspaper Hokkaido Shimbun published a letter from Nozomi Imai, wife of the paper’s journalist Yuki Imai, who was arrested in Russia on espionage charges. In the letter, Nozomi describes how the family is coping with her husband’s arrest and calls for his release. The letter (available as a PDF) is handwritten in three languages: Japanese, English, and Russian, and is addressed “to everyone.”
